data.explanation: This is an invoice for certified document translations. You should transfer €142.80 to the IBAN given, quoting invoice number BT-26-4407 as the payment reference, by the deadline shown by the app (21 days after the invoice date). The letter does not state what happens if you miss this deadline, but late payment of invoices can lead to reminders or late fees, so it's best to pay on time. Keep this invoice, as certified translations obtained for work, study or immigration purposes may be tax-deductible.
